<!-- review-mining -->
Review findings that came back on more than one pull request of `example/app` updated in the last 90 days (since 2026-07-03), read from the "Agent review" and "Second review" comments and counted per kind of `AGENTS.md`'s "Mistakes that keep coming back". A kind is listed when it appears on two or more pull requests and isn't fully checked, or when it is checked and still appears (the check misses a case); dismissed findings don't count. Each run rewrites this issue; a row is closed by a check, not by a new sentence in `AGENTS.md`. Tick a row and it becomes an Agent task: the tick and the issue opened from it stay through each rewrite.

### Repeated findings

| Kind | State | Pull requests | Fixed | Last seen | Proposed check |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Failure paths** | human-judged | [#10](https://github.com/example/app/pull/10), [#11](https://github.com/example/app/pull/11) | 1 | 2026-09-11 | a test of what the user sees on the failing path @​octocat <!-- x --> |
| **Layout** | human-judged | [#12](https://github.com/example/app/pull/12), [#13](https://github.com/example/app/pull/13) | 0 | 2026-09-12 | screenshots at phone and desktop widths from `make verify` |

- [ ] <!-- row:repeated:failure-paths --> **Failure paths** becomes an Agent task
- [ ] <!-- row:repeated:layout --> **Layout** becomes an Agent task

### Often dismissed

Kinds with at least 3 findings dismissed by the owner in the window, dismissals being at least half of the kind's findings: the reviewer's guidance needs to say when this isn't a finding.

| Kind | Raised | Fixed | Dismissed | Dismissal reasons | Proposal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Layout** | 5 | 1 | 4 | "desktop-only page" (#12) | Review guidance: say when this isn't a finding, in the app's `.github/agent-review/context.md` or in fleet's `prompt.md` if it holds for every app |

- [ ] <!-- row:dismissed:layout --> **Layout** becomes an Agent task

### Open at merge

Findings still open when their pull request merged in the window, per kind: the merge path let them through.

| Kind | Open at merge | Pull requests |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Failure paths** | 2 | [#14](https://github.com/example/app/pull/14) |

- [ ] <!-- row:open-at-merge:failure-paths --> **Failure paths** becomes an Agent task

<sub>4 pull request(s) updated in the window, 4 with review findings. From fleet's review-mining.yml ([run](https://example.invalid/run/1)).</sub>
